name: Keep in Touch
description: Personal CRM — never let someone you care about go quiet. Daily nudge, one-tap check-ins.

tools.name: add_person
tools.description: Add (or update) a person to keep in touch with. cadence_days is how often to reach out (default 14). handle is their phone number, email, or iMessage handle.

handle.description: Phone number, email, or iMessage handle

notes.description: Optional context — how you know them, what to ask about

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: List everyone being kept in touch with: name, handle, cadence, notes, last touch, and whether they're due.

tools.name: due_today
tools.description: People who are due (or overdue) for a check-in right now, most overdue first.

tools.name: log_touch
tools.description: Record that the user reached out to a person (resets their cadence clock). Use after a call, text, or meetup happened outside the app.

tools.name: send_checkin
tools.description: Send a check-in text to a stored person via Messages and log the touch. body is the message text to send.
